metadata.chapter_subtitle: Gasoline, Diesel, and Jet Fuel Across the Western Canadian Supply Chain

inventory.summary: The chapter's logistics model was already clear, but it needed a learner-facing setup block so batching, transmix, and terminal inventory were framed before the equations.
issues: The chapter lacked a Before You Start section.
Readers benefit from a clearer advance frame around batch sequencing and terminal timing.
The pipeline sequence needed more consistent chapter-entry design.

rewrite.summary: Added onboarding and preserved the batch scheduling, transmix, and terminal inventory treatment.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section.
Used the setup block to foreground the one-pipe, many-products problem.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now enters more gently while preserving the mathematical and logistical correctness of the refined-products supply-chain model.

repair.summary: The repair focused on pacing and reader setup rather than on structural changes to the content.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Clarified the batching and transmix problem before the equations.
Preserved the terminal and scheduling analysis.

design_review.summary: The chapter's logistics explanations remain strong, and the new opening improves interpretive support for the batch and terminal visuals.
improvements_made: Added learner-facing prerequisites and focus guidance.
Retained the chapter's strong batch-and-terminal logistics structure.
Improved interpretive access to the supply-chain timing logic.
